title: His own band: the novelty number, soloists and high-pitched vocals
summary: Albert plays a novelty number his band used, once cut off the air in Pensacola, and identifies soloists Herbert Hall, Lloyd Glenn, Louis Cottrell and Hiram Hardy; he notes the high-pitched singing copied Orlando Roberson.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
